title: Cartan Equation Solution — Spin-Torsion Coupling
plaintext:
EINSTEIN-CARTAN TORSION SOLUTION
================================
Cartan equation: T^a_bc + δ^a_b T_c - δ^a_c T_b = 8πG · s^a_bc

Torsion components (m⁻¹):
  T⁰₀₁ = 0.987861    T⁰₀₂ = -1.002628    T⁰₀₃ = -1.003487
  T¹₁₂ = 0.983630    T¹₁₃ = -1.011417    T²₂₃ = 0.840752

|T| = 2.3844e+0 m⁻¹
λ (coupling) = -14.1270
σ (spin density) = 1.8439e-2 J·s/m³
